Id1.text: The All India Council for Technical Education which is located in Mumbai, was proud to give the Technical Campus status to the Acharya Institute of Technology. The president of the Acharya Institute of Technology is B. M. Reddy and it is affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University. The campus address for the Acharya Institute of Technology is: Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore - 560090.
